full_citation: OpenAI (2026-05-20). 'An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry.' Official announcement at openai.com/index/model-disproves-discrete-geometry-conjecture/. First fully autonomous proof of a central open problem in mathematics: U(n) grows superlinearly with exponent > 1 (inexplicit), refuting the long-held belief that square-grid constructions are optimal. Produced by a general-purpose internal reasoning model — not domain-trained, not scaffolded for proof search, not targeted at the unit-distance problem.
